```{r}
#Question 1A
ages <- c(34, 28, 22, 36, 27, 18, 52, 39, 42, 29, 35, 31, 27, 22, 37, 34, 19,
          20, 57, 49, 50, 37, 46, 25, 17, 37, 43, 53, 41, 51, 35, 24, 33, 41,
          53, 40, 18, 44, 38, 41, 48, 27, 39, 19, 30, 61, 54, 58, 26, 18)

#Question 1B
print(length(ages))

#Question 1C
print(min(ages))
print(max(ages))

#Question 1D
print(ages[c(13:18, 33:35)])

#Question 1E
print(ages[-c(10, 20, 30, 40)])

#Question 1F
ages[c(4, 14, 24, 44)] <- 0
print(ages)

#Question 2A
data(rivers)

n    <- length(rivers)
total <- sum(rivers)
avg  <- mean(rivers)
med  <- median(rivers)
v    <- var(rivers)
std  <- sd(rivers)
minimum <- min(rivers)
maximum <- max(rivers)

print(n)
print(total)
print(avg)
print(med)
print(v)
print(std)
print(minimum)
print(maximum)

#Question 2B
rivers_stats <- c(
  length   = length(rivers),
  sum      = sum(rivers),
  mean     = mean(rivers),
  median   = median(rivers),
  variance = var(rivers),
  sd       = sd(rivers),
  min      = min(rivers),
  max      = max(rivers)
)

print(rivers_stats)

#Question 3A
power_ranking <- 1:25

celebrity_name <- c("Tom Cruise", "Rolling Stones", "Oprah Winfrey", "U2",
                    "Tiger Woods", "Steven Spielberg", "Howard Stern", "50 Cent",
                    "Cast of the Sopranos", "Dan Brown", "Bruce Springsteen",
                    "Donald Trump", "Muhammad Ali", "Paul McCartney", "George Lucas",
                    "Elton John", "David Letterman", "Phil Mickelson", "J.K. Rowling",
                    "Bradd Pitt", "Peter Jackson", "Dr. Phil McGraw", "Jay Lenon",
                    "Celine Dion", "Kobe Bryant")

pay <- c(67, 90, 225, 110, 90, 332, 302, 41, 52, 88, 55, 44, 55,
         40, 233, 34, 40, 47, 75, 25, 39, 45, 32, 40, 31)

print(power_ranking)
print(celebrity_name)
print(pay)

#Question 3B
# J.K. Rowling is at index 19
power_ranking[19] <- 15
pay[19] <- 90

cat("Updated Power Ranking of J.K. Rowling:", power_ranking[19], "\n")
cat("Updated Pay of J.K. Rowling:", pay[19], "\n")

#Question 4A
vegetables <- c("Carrot", "Broccoli", "Spinach", "Cabbage", "Eggplant",
                "Tomato", "Cucumber", "Potato", "Onion", "Garlic")
print(vegetables)

#Question 4B

print(vegetables)

#Question 4C
print(length(vegetables))

#Question 4D
vegetables <- append(vegetables, c("Zucchini", "Kale", "Leek", "Radish"), after = 5)
```
